门外，二十岁的傻子陈楚、骑着一只木条板凳，手握粪叉，大叫着：“抓曹贼！抓曹贼！”
三年前，要不是陈楚搭救自己，她已经被蒙面的坏人祸害了，但那次，陈楚也被打成了傻子。
陈楚父母为了赚钱治病，去大城市打工了，她为了报恩，便把陈楚接到自己家住。
而她爹，现在把她许配给了村长儿子李大伟，马上就要完婚了。
朱丽娜看向陈楚英俊的面庞，如果他不是傻子，该有多好啊。
那个未婚夫李大伟，个头还不到一米六，还没自己高。
“傻哥，你也进来洗澡，先脱衣服。”
陈楚几下脱掉衣裳，进了洗澡的大盆里。
“好看，你比明星都好看，就是太白了，而且……”
朱丽娜蹙眉，是不是她哪里不好看？让陈楚不满意？
“不过小明给我看小片的时候，都有马赛克啊，你这里怎么没有？”
“傻哥，你真是气死我了……”朱丽娜又羞又气，扑入他的怀里。
“傻哥，我就要做别人的媳妇了，今天，我们做夫妻好不好？”
这时候，外面传来父母和村长说话的声音。
大喊道：“爹，你们别进来，我正在洗澡呢！”
“你们也算是两口子了，你媳妇洗澡，你进去帮忙搓搓背。”

“有啥使不得的？二十万彩礼你们已经收了，要不然你退回来啊？”
朱丽娜爹朱长发，外号朱老蔫、胆小怕事。
“彩礼已经收了，小娜就是人家的人了，姑爷，你进去，她没插门。”
一边找衣服往身上穿，一边大声呵斥。
外面的李长贵笑了：“都二十岁的大姑娘了，有啥害羞的，老蔫啊，咱们就别在这当电灯泡了，去我那喝喝茶吧。”
朱老蔫拉着满脸担心的媳妇往外走。
还有，两条大白腿，全体白花花的朱丽娜。
“朱丽娜，你比天上的仙女都要美，我爱你……”
李大伟脱了自己衣裳，朝朱丽娜扑去。
“朱丽娜，让我来好好的品尝你的滋味吧……”

Outside the door, a 20-year-old fool named Chen Chu was riding on a wooden bench, holding a manure fork in his hand, shouting: "Catch the thief Cao! Catch the thief Cao!"
Three years ago, if Chen Chu hadn't rescued her, she would have been harmed by masked bad guys, but that time, Chen Chu was also beaten into a fool.
Chen Chu's parents went to work in big cities to make money for medical treatment. In order to repay her kindness, she took Chen Chu to live in her home.
And her father has now betrothed her to the village chief's son, Li Dawei, and is about to get married soon.
Zhu Lina looked at Chen Chu's handsome face. It would be great if he was not a fool.
That fiancé, Li Dawei, is less than 1.6 meters tall and is not taller than himself.
"Silly brother, you come in and take a shower too, take off your clothes first."
Chen Chu took off his clothes several times and got into the big basin for bathing.
"You're good-looking. You're prettier than celebrities, but you're too white, and..."
Zhulina frowned, is there something bad about her? Make Chen Chu dissatisfied?
"But when Xiao Ming showed me the short films, they all had mosaics. Why don't you have them here?"
"Silly brother, you are so angry with me..." Zhulina was ashamed and angry, and threw herself into his arms.
"Silly brother, I am going to be someone else's wife. Today, can we be husband and wife?"
At this time, the voices of parents and village chief talking were heard outside.
Shouted: "Dad, don't come in, I'm taking a shower!"
"You can be considered a couple. Your wife takes a bath, and you go in and help her rub her back."
"What's wrong? You've already accepted the two hundred thousand gift, how about you return it?"
Zhu Lina's father, Zhu Changfa, nicknamed Zhu Laowang, is timid and afraid of getting into trouble.
"The betrothal gift has been collected, and Xiaona is now hers. Uncle, you go in, she didn't interrupt the door."
While looking for clothes to put on, he yelled loudly.
Li Changgui outside smiled: "You are a twenty-year-old girl, what is there to be shy about? You old wizened man, let's stop being light bulbs here and go to my place for tea."
Zhu Laowen took his worried daughter-in-law out.
Also, Zhu Lina has two big white legs and is all white.
"Julina, you are more beautiful than the fairies in the sky, I love you..."
Li Dawei took off his clothes and threw himself at Zhu Lina.
"Julina, let me taste you..."
